project_type: Python FastAPI service within a TypeScript monorepo
build_system: setuptools, no build step required for Python service
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests
build_command: No build required (Python interpreted). For full project: would be npm/pnpm workspace commands
verification_instructions: Run pytest after each change: `python -m pytest tests/unit/ -v` for unit tests, `python -m pytest tests/integration/ -v` for integration tests, `python -m pytest tests/ -v` for full suite before commit
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - Python service does not generate checked-in files. Tests validate in-memory contract objects and mocked snapshots
environment_constraints: Must run from services/project-ai directory. Requires Python 3.11+. Repository snapshot at packages/project-llm-discovery/output/snapshot.json is read but not modified. WorkflowGovernanceService and in-memory contracts_store are Wave 2 placeholders (will be replaced in Wave 3)
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns in services/project-ai. Use Pydantic models for data validation. Maintain architectural boundary: Python consumes TypeScript snapshots, never scans repository directly. All contract fields must be evidence-backed. Tests must verify evidence traceability and determinism
key_patterns: Pydantic BaseModel for all data models, snake_case for Python identifiers, type hints required, async/await for route handlers, dependency injection via FastAPI Depends(), unit tests with fixtures in conftest.py, integration tests mock snapshot loading
directory_structure: services/project-ai/ contains: app/ (application code with api/routes/, contracts/, models/, orchestration/), tests/ (unit/, integration/, e2e/), pyproject.toml. Contracts module defines EngineeringContract and RepositoryBlockContract models. Repository intelligence extracts evidence from TypeScript snapshot. Routes module handles HTTP endpoints and calls governance service
